title: Lighter Eton Mess
description: A quick single-serve take on the classic English dessert, layering whipped ice cream and yogurt with meringue and fresh strawberries.
ingredients: 1 meringue nest, broken into small pieces
steps: Put ice cream and yogurt in a small bowl; mash with a fork until smooth and whippy.
Layer the ice cream mix, meringue and strawberries in a pretty glass or bowl.
notes: Also great with blueberries, raspberries or diced mango.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
